M-S4c-rows1-21-small-listings-190rc4-202.objective: M9 S4c on 1.9.0rc4 (8abc2c1): the final revision's fresh qualification and progressive coverage of rows 0-21 (never collected by 1.8 or 1.9): the 31 listings of rows 1-21 that the census of 2026-11-02 measured at 18 to 48 products (1,021 products; at most 2 pages each, 55 pages), in one logical run with one lane. Measured: whether at least 500 distinct fresh valid products come from one logical run of the final revision (about 700 products are on these listings' first pages, so it holds even if every page 2 repeats page 1), the repeat on page 2, the new tile on other departments. Not a coverage claim for these rows: each row is narrowed to the listed listings. Known before this stage (O2 2026-11-06; S1b, S4, S5a, S5b and S3 on 1.9.0rc3, 2026-11-09): an unrendered listing answer for ?page=N can carry page 1's products under ranks shifted by 24(N-1), or repeat an earlier page exactly; the collector then ends that listing as incomplete (repeated page). It is intermittent and clustered in time, not tied to a listing: in S4, 8 page-N answers repeated page 1 from 14:33:35Z to 14:36:51Z between distinct ones; in S5a (14:42-14:45Z) the four listings that had repeated in S4 paged, with one repeat (School Office page 4); in S5b (14:51Z) Light Bulbs and School Office repeated again; in S3 (14:57Z) Milk's page 4 repeated an earlier page. S5b's two-lane run on 1.9.0rc3 was rejected by G13: a lane wrote the other lane's page to the database before its answer arrived (6 of 13 listing-page rows); 1.9.0rc4 corrects this.

M-S4c-rows1-21-small-listings-190rc4-202.retry_policy: the collector's own, as shipped: a listing page up to 3 attempts on 408/429/5xx with backoff (failed requests are documented as not charged; every attempt is still reserved at its worst case); a rendered listing answer without tiles is asked again, three in a row stop the run resumably (PROVIDER_ERROR); the stage is not repeated before its outcome is read
M-S4c-rows1-21-small-listings-190rc4-202.stop_conditions: the store or PICKUP not verified on a page; the canary failing; a refusal page; 401/402/403 or a quota answer; ABNORMAL_RESULT; the stage's or the collector's ceiling; more than 2 outcomes unknown; lease loss; the key fingerprint differing from the noted one; the deadline
